links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT lung cancer answers on nine readability formulas
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease 40.52; Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 12.56; Gunning FOG 13.63; SMOG 14.61; ARI 15.04; Coleman-Liau 14.24; answers at college level and above and difficult to read.
links.quote: The readability levels of the answers generated by ChatGPT are "collage" and above and are difficult to read.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the readability of ChatGPT responses to lung cancer questions using standard readability formulas, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
